scope: Curriculum inventory and source-bound historical receipt verification; no fresh numerical execution, independent learner assessment or hardware qualification.

phases.title: Setup & first steps
phases.furtherWork: Fresh-machine Windows/Linux/macOS walkthroughs and novice usability sessions remain unverified; accelerator setup needs a separately observed device run.

phases.title: Arrays & pure functions
phases.furtherWork: Sparse and ragged inputs need additional contract-focused labs; this phase deliberately teaches fixed dense arrays first.

phases.title: JAX transformations
phases.furtherWork: Transformation combinations involving nondifferentiable boundaries require further examples; passing smooth fixtures does not validate arbitrary gradients.

phases.title: State, randomness & control flow
phases.furtherWork: Local deterministic state does not establish concurrent-writer or multi-host recovery; the recovery and operations phases extend these boundaries.

phases.title: Math & optimization
phases.furtherWork: Constrained, nonsmooth and large-scale stochastic optimization are not covered comprehensively. Current ranking evidence is limited to declared synthetic objectives.

phases.title: Neural network training
phases.furtherWork: Natural-image dataset ingestion, richer augmentation studies and pretrained vision transfer remain larger follow-up labs; synthetic images do not establish real-photo generalization.

phases.title: Data & checkpoint recovery
phases.furtherWork: Network storage failures, concurrent checkpoint writers and true multi-host recovery still need separate failure-injection qualification.

phases.title: Transformers & language models
phases.furtherWork: Real-corpus curation, tokenizer tradeoff studies, long-context evaluation and live generative quality need further labs beyond the tiny byte-model harness.

phases.title: Performance diagnosis
phases.furtherWork: CPU traces do not characterize TPU/GPU communication or memory. Target traces and sustained workload measurements remain required for accelerator claims.

phases.title: Distributed training
phases.furtherWork: Real network collectives, multi-controller ingestion and host-loss recovery are unqualified. The optional launch instructions are preparation, not execution receipts.

phases.title: Scientific computing
phases.furtherWork: Adaptive solvers, event handling, stiff systems, PDEs and domain-specific physical validation remain outside the scalar ODE lab.

phases.title: Probabilistic modeling
phases.furtherWork: General hierarchical models and robust modern diagnostic workflows need further examples. The instructional sampler is not a replacement for validated inference libraries.

phases.title: Reinforcement learning
phases.furtherWork: Continuous actions, value-function estimation and larger benchmark environments need new implementation and evaluation labs; this tabular task is deliberately bounded.

phases.title: Pallas kernels
phases.furtherWork: Actual TPU/GPU compilation, race diagnosis and target tuning remain unqualified; CPU interpretation cannot close these gaps.

phases.title: Autodiff & JAX internals
phases.furtherWork: The tiny interpreter is intentionally incomplete. Production extension APIs, effects and full compiler transformation coverage require further targeted work.

phases.title: Deployment, interoperability & edge AI
phases.furtherWork: Actual edge-device delegates, thermal/energy budgets, packed low-bit kernels and production serving loads remain unqualified. The revised sequence moves adaptation before export and containerization before service capacity planning.

phases.title: Workload operations
phases.furtherWork: Authenticated review, multi-writer promotion, staged cloud rollout, SLO alerting and live-model abuse evaluation still require separate infrastructure and application-specific labs.

phases.title: Self-supervised pretraining: masked and contrastive learning
phases.furtherWork: Full BERT/ViT masked autoencoders, natural corpora, augmentation studies and downstream probe benchmarks remain extensions. The current labs execute small attention, linear reconstruction and embedding models.

phases.title: Post-training: SFT, LoRA, reward models and RLHF
phases.furtherWork: The PPO lab is a terminal synthetic preference bandit, not full language-model RLHF. Human preference collection, sequence PPO/value models, large-model PEFT and held-out human evaluation remain separate work.
